name: MEI
subtitle: Xentinel Tactical Combat & Electromagnetic Dominance Unit

versions.quote: If saving you is a sin, I will gladly become a sinner. The lightning obeys my command.
versions.description: Engineered as an apex vanguard assault combat maiden. Channeling concentrated electromagnetic plasma and magnetic singularity blades, Mei operates as the premier frontline sentinel, defending civic perimeters and neutralising hostile breaches with lightning supremacy.

workExperience.desc: Lead commander of high-threat interception and rapid reactionary counter-strike operations.
Calibrated dual Kurikara-matrix lightning converters for supersonic kinetic warfare.

abilities.name: Thundering Sanction
abilities.desc: Calls down superheated ionic lightning strikes, disintegrating shields in a 60-meter radius.

abilities.name: Kurikara's Tempest
abilities.desc: Summons resonant dragonic electromagnetic aura to slice through reinforced armored battle-cruisers.

abilities.name: Tacheon Edge Flash
abilities.desc: Unsheathes relativistic blade causing localized space-time shearing.
